scripts.check:go: cd compiler && go list ./... && go vet ./... && staticcheck ./... && deadcode -test ./...
scripts.check:tooling: deno lint compiler/native-bindings/build.ts dupl.ts && deno check compiler/native-bindings/build.ts dupl.ts
scripts.build: npm run compiler && npm run native-bindings && npm run build -w @depths/tach && npm run build -w @tach/browser-test && npm run build -w @tach/native-test && npm run build -w @tach/showcase
scripts.check: npm run check:go && npm run check:tooling && npm run check:duplicates && go -C compiler test -race ./... && npm run build && npm run check -w @depths/tach && npm run check -w @tach/browser-test && npm run check -w @tach/native-test && npm run check -w @tach/showcase
scripts.test: npm run check && npm test -w @depths/tach && npm test -w @tach/browser-test && npm run test:native && npm test -w @tach/showcase
